title: Ionic Bonding and Formula Units
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: Ionic transfer and lattice model analysis using formula tables. No synthesis or mixing is required.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for bonding models, molecular geometry, ionic/covalent comparisons, and intermolecular forces
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, use the molecule-building workspace. Use the available atom kit to build the molecule or formula named in the lesson activity. Count each element in the completed model and compare the count to the written chemical formula. Record the formula, element counts, model evidence, and any naming or formula rule used in Ionic Bonding and Formula Units.
simulationReviewImplementation: Student-facing lesson includes one exact direct simulation/resource link plus adjacent step-by-step directions for what to open, click/use, observe, record, and connect to the lesson standard.
